lead_raw_text:
The structure of YbPd crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing four atoms and two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Pd and Yb centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors each: Pd is surrounded by 8 Pd and 4 Yb, while Yb is surrounded by 4 Pd and 8 Yb, at neighbor distances of 2.8418–2.904 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all four sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal corner- and edge-sharing between Pd-centered and Yb-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, as well as edge-sharing among Pd polyhedra and among Yb polyhedra.
